# 02 An edge carries a label

## Outcome

`A -->|yes| B` and `A -- yes --> B` both draw `yes` on the edge, with dagre holding room for it.

## Why this ticket exists

The pairing that makes board 5's decision diamond useful: a diamond with unlabelled edges leaving it
says nothing about which branch is which.

**This is a port, not new machinery.** `layoutDirectedGraph` already accepts an edge label's width
and height, gives dagre room for it, and returns a `labelAnchor`; `layoutClassDiagram` and
`renderClassDiagramToSVG` have drawn relationship labels through that path since the class board.
What is missing is only that a flowchart edge has never had a label to pass. **Read those two
before writing anything** — if you find yourself adding a parameter to `layoutDirectedGraph`, stop
and check whether it is already there.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both spellings parse to the same label on the same edge. Assert they produce **identical**
      documents apart from nothing — the way board 4 asserted `graph` against `flowchart`, so a
      field recording which spelling was used would fail rather than pass unnoticed.
- [ ] The label reaches dagre as a reserved box and the edge routes around it. Assert at the
      **layout** seam that a labelled edge's geometry differs from an unlabelled one's; a renderer
      test cannot see reserved space.
- [ ] The label is drawn at its anchor, in an element the theme paints. Check what class the class
      diagram uses for the same thing and decide whether to share it or mint a sibling — say which
      and why.
- [ ] Label text is measured with the same `TextMeasurer` everything else uses, so a long label
      reserves more room than a short one. Assert it.
- [ ] An edge label containing the characters the grammar would eat — `|`, `-->`, `;` — is handled.
      **Measure Mermaid** for each rather than deciding: `A -->|a-->b| B` and `A -- a;b --> B` are
      the interesting ones.
- [ ] **`linkStyle 0 color:#f00` is NOT wired to the new label in this ticket.** Board 3 routes
      `color` into an author style's text half, and an edge has had nowhere to put it; this ticket
      gives it somewhere. Making that connection changes what an existing directive does and is
      the board's stated non-goal — **record it as a finding for the closing ticket instead.**
- [ ] Two corpus rows move to `supported`, asserting the drawn label. Expect `REJECTED` 15 → **13**.
      `SILENTLY_WRONG` stays at 3.

## Test seam

`parseFlowchart` for both spellings; `layoutGraph` for the reserved room; `render()` for the drawn
label; the corpus.
